description: Erection of a first floor rear extension and formation of a roof terrace with a 1.7m high obscured glazed screen above the single storey rear extension
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The proposed extension by reason of its design, massing, and location would introduce an overly large and bulky form of development failing to remain subservient to or integrate with the host property whilst resulting in an uncharacteristic and visually intrusive form of development causing less than substantial harm to the Old York Road Conservation Area with no public benefit. The proposal would be contrary to Local Plan policies LP1, LP3 and LP5 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) and the Housing SPD (2016) Adopted Local Plan and the Wandsworth Housing SPD (2016). Furthermore, the proposal does not meet the statutory duties of Sec.72 (1) of the Planning (Listed Building and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 and does not comply with Policy HC1 of the London Plan (2021). There are no heritage benefits to outweigh the harm, so therefore the proposal fails the tests of NPPF (2025) paras.212-215.

Reason : 2 - In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. We have made available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies in the Local Plan consisting of the Core Strategy, Development Management Policies Document, Supplementary Planning documents and where appropriate the Site Specific Allocations Document as well as offering a full pre application advice service. However, we have been unable to seek solutions to problems as the principle of the proposal is clearly contrary to our statutory policies and negotiation could not overcome the reasons for refusal.
